name: flow
description: Phased development workflow: setup → research → plan → gated plan review → implement → review-against-plan → gated report → wind-down. Durable file-based state, resumable from any session. Plus /flow shape: upstream ticket shaping (brainstorm → agreed tracker tickets).

terminal.title: Terminal
terminal.description: What the flow mod's terminal button and /flow-term open in a task's worktree. iterm-split and tmux split the pane Claude Code runs in, side by side.

splitSide.title: Split side
splitSide.description: Where an iterm-split or tmux terminal opens beside Claude Code's pane. Right and bottom at 50% need nothing more; any other split uses iTerm's Python API (Settings → General → Magic → Enable Python API), which flow sets up in ~/.cache/flow on first use.

splitSize.title: Split size (%)
splitSize.description: The new pane's share of Claude Code's pane, 10 to 90.

editor.title: Editor
editor.description: What the flow mod's editor button and /flow-code open a task's worktree in.
